episodes.title: Colour Is Illegal. Her Heart Caught Fire | Part 1
episodes.hook: In a city where colour is a crime, her heart just caught fire.
episodes.cliffhanger: Ren, the Inkguard's hunter, sentences her from the rooftop. Every Ember is taught never to burn on purpose, and Akari answers: 'Watch me.'
episodes.synopsis: Cold open on Akari's chest igniting red in a grey market. Cinderhollow, ash, the Inkguard painting colour away. Akari tells herself to feel nothing; a runaway cart rolls at a child; Dai shouts; she lunges, catches the child, and her ember flares in front of everyone. The crowd turns to stare. A whistle: Ren on the rooftop, brush-blade drawn.

episodes.title: She Broke the Only Rule an Ember Has | Part 2
episodes.hook: Every Ember is taught one rule. She just broke it in front of the whole city.
episodes.cliffhanger: Cornered in a dead-end alley with Ren's blade at her scarf, a door opens behind her and an old hand pulls her in: 'Tea?'
episodes.synopsis: Akari burns on purpose for the first time; it's wild and she can't aim it. Rooftop chase: Ren is faster and colder. His blade cuts her scarf. Dai crashes his father's lantern cart into Ren to buy her a second. She runs into an alley that ends in a wall.

episodes.title: The Old Woman Who Saved Her Used to Hunt Her | Part 3
episodes.hook: The old woman who saved her used to hunt girls like her.
episodes.cliffhanger: A knock at the teahouse door. Sumi opens it to Ren and says: 'Hello, Ren. You've grown.'
episodes.synopsis: Inside the Last Lantern teahouse, Sumi shows Akari a hidden room of coloured lanterns, the only colour left in the city. Her first lesson: you can't put a feeling out, you can only aim it. Akari learns Sumi was once Captain of the Inkguard. Dai arrives with news: the Inkguard are searching door to door.

episodes.title: Every Time She Burns, the Sky Wakes Up | Part 4
episodes.hook: Every time an Ember burns, something in the sky opens its eyes.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Hush's ink tendrils close around Dai in the middle of the market, and Akari is too far away.
episodes.synopsis: Sumi and Ren's standoff: he was her student. Before either strikes, the ash stops falling, the first time in a hundred years. A Hush descends on the market, swallowing breath and sound. Ren orders a retreat; Akari refuses. Dai stayed behind to get a child to safety.

episodes.title: There's Only One Thing a Hush Fears: Her | Part 5
episodes.hook: There's only one thing a Hush is afraid of, and it just walked into the market.
episodes.cliffhanger: On a rooftop, Ren peels off his glove: the ink brand on his hand is burning blue. He has been hiding the same fire.
episodes.synopsis: PAYOFF of Arc 1. Akari chooses to burn, aimed this time, the way Sumi taught her. She tears Dai out of the Hush and burns it to ash; for three seconds the whole market is in colour and nobody looks away. The crowd that stared at her in Part 1 now sees what she is. Dai, coughing, grins: 'Told you you were cool.'

episodes.title: The Boy Hunting Her Has a Fire Too | Part 1
episodes.hook: The boy sent to hunt her has been hiding a fire of his own.
episodes.cliffhanger: Ren gives Akari a choice: come with him to the Ward Tower tonight, or tomorrow the Inkguard grey his memories away.
episodes.synopsis: Ren's story in flashback panels: taken as a child, branded with ward-ink to smother his blue ember, raised to hunt his own kind. He failed to bring Akari in; the punishment for failure is greying. He corners her not to fight, but to ask.

episodes.title: She Walked Into the Inkguard's Tower on Purpose | Part 2
episodes.hook: She walked into the Inkguard's tower on purpose, in handcuffs.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Inkguard Commander removes his mask. Dai knows the face: it's his father, the lantern-maker who vanished.
episodes.synopsis: The plan: Ren 'delivers' Akari, Dai sneaks in as a supply porter, Sumi waits below. Inside: rows of silent grey children, Embers whose memories were painted over. Akari realises the grey isn't paint. It's forgetting.

episodes.title: Red and Blue Fire Were Never Meant to Touch | Part 3
episodes.hook: Red and blue fire were never supposed to touch.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Commander brushes greying ink over Akari's ember. Her colour drains, and she looks at Dai and asks who he is.
episodes.synopsis: Ren breaks his brand and ignites blue for the first time in years; side by side with Akari, red and blue braid into a violet blaze. Dai faces his father, who says the grey keeps the Hush asleep. The Commander's ink is faster than both of them.

episodes.title: She Forgot His Name. He Made Her Remember | Part 4
episodes.hook: She forgot his name. He made her remember without a single power.
episodes.cliffhanger: That night, alone, Sumi opens a sealed box: the first jar of Hush-ink, labelled in her own brush hand. 'I'm sorry, Akari. I started this.'
episodes.synopsis: PAYOFF of Arc 2. Dai, powerless, talks to the grey Akari: the day they met, the lantern he built her, the joke only she laughs at. Her ember relights from the inside. Together they free the greyed children; Ren holds the stairs; the Commander is left alone with the lanterns his son made.

episodes.title: A Hundred Years Ago, She Painted the Sky Black | Part 1
episodes.hook: A hundred years ago, one girl painted the sky black. She's still alive.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Inkguard storm the teahouse. Sumi stays behind with her brush raised: 'Go. Burn bright.'
episodes.synopsis: Sumi's confession: a war of Embers was burning the city, and the young ink-master brewed an ink to smother every fire. It worked too well: it became the Hush, it took the colour, and its ink has kept her alive ever since. The kids are furious, then quiet.

episodes.title: The Greatest Ink-Master Let Them Take Her | Part 2
episodes.hook: The strongest ink-master alive just let them take her.
episodes.cliffhanger: From the crown of the caldera, the Inkguard release the Great Hush, and it swallows the sun.
episodes.synopsis: Sumi is carried to the caldera's crown to be used as the heart of a Great Hush that will smother every Ember for good. Akari, Ren and Dai argue, then plan: Dai's lanterns as a beacon, Ren's map of the Inkguard routes, Akari's fire as the key.

episodes.title: Three Kids Against a Sky That Ate the Sun | Part 3
episodes.hook: Red, blue and gold: three kids against a sky that ate the sun.
episodes.cliffhanger: A tendril of the Great Hush wraps Ren and drags him up into the dark. His blue light goes out.
episodes.synopsis: The climb up the caldera at noon-turned-midnight. Dai lights a hundred gold lanterns along the rim so the city can see; people come out of their houses for the first time. Akari and Ren fight up the last stairs back to back.

episodes.title: Every Colour You Lost Is Inside the Dark | Part 4
episodes.hook: Inside the Hush, every colour you ever lost is waiting.
episodes.cliffhanger: At the heart of the Hush they find Sumi, young again, and she is the thing holding it together.
episodes.synopsis: Akari jumps in after Ren. Inside: a silent ocean of stolen colours and swallowed memories. Ren, drifting, sees his mother's face in blue. Akari reaches him by being honest for once: she's been scared her whole life. His flame relights.

episodes.title: To End the Grey, Someone Has to Burn It | Part 5
episodes.hook: To end the grey, someone has to burn it from the inside.
episodes.cliffhanger: Beyond the caldera wall, another grey city, and in its square a fire that burns black. Season 2.
episodes.synopsis: SERIES PAYOFF. Sumi gives back the hundred years her ink stole, and Akari and Ren burn together through the Hush. It breaks into rain, and the rain has colour in it. The first sunrise in a hundred years over Cinderhollow, full colour, the whole cast on the rim. Sumi's brush, left on the stairs.
